card.name: Two-colourings of [1,256] with few monochromatic four-term progressions

task.name: Two-colourings of [1,256] with few monochromatic four-term progressions
task.description: construct() -> 256 colours in {0,1} for the integers 1..256. Minimize the exact number of monochromatic 4-term arithmetic progressions a, a+d, a+2d, a+3d with d >= 1 inside 1..256. The finite count for n = 256 and k = 4 upper-bounds the minimum for this n; no exact finite value is documented.
